basic_info.description: Experience stunning Bay and Bridge views from this rarely available, top-floor townhouse condo at Telegraph Landing. Thoughtfully designed with sleek, modern finishes, this spacious two-level home is perfect for contemporary living and effortless entertaining.    The main level features hardwood floors, elegant living and dining areas, and an open-concept chef's kitchen with Bay Bridge views and a private patio. Upstairs, a spectacular deeded rooftop terrace (approximately 474 square feet)  offers 360-degree views of Coit Tower, Downtown, and the Bay Bridge. Sun-drenched all day and magical at night, it's an ideal setting to relax or host unforgettable evening gatherings under the city lights.    On the lower level, two bedrooms and two full baths, including a primary suite with en-suite bath. Additional highlights include generous closets, in-unit laundry, and garage storage. A deeded parking space in a gated garage completes this exceptional offering.    Located in the sunbelt of the North Waterfront, you're just steps from The Embarcadero, Ferry Building, SF Bay Club, and North Beach. Telegraph Landing offers 24/7 security, a gym, lush communal gardens, rooftop terraces, and a function room. A true urban retreat, balancing serenity and vibrant city living.
